images.alt_grc: ὁ Ἀρίστων καὶ ὁ Σύρος τὰς κύλικας ἐν τῇ ἀγορᾷ τάττουσιν· ὄπισθεν ἡ ποικίλη στοά.
images.alt_en: Dawn in the Agora: Ariston and Syros set out cups in a circle; the Painted Stoa behind.

images.alt_grc: ἐν τῇ στοᾷ οἱ νέοι περὶ τὸν Σωκράτη κύκλον πεποίηνται.
images.alt_en: In the Painted Stoa young men stand in a circle round a snub-nosed, barefoot Socrates; the Marathon painting on the wall.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Σωκράτης γελᾷ· ὁ νεανίας ὀργίζεται· ὁ Λύσις θαυμάζει.
images.alt_en: Socrates laughs, the young man scowls, Lysis listens open-mouthed.

images.alt_grc: ἡ ποικίλη στοὰ ἐν τῇ ἀγορᾷ
images.alt_en: Plan or reconstruction of the Stoa Poikile on the north side of the Athenian Agora (target: ASCSA Agora excavations, CC BY).

images.alt_grc: ἡ ποικίλη στοά
images.alt_en: A long colonnade with painted panels: the Stoa Poikile.

images.alt_grc: ὁ κύκλος
images.alt_en: A circle; people standing in a ring.

images.alt_grc: ὁ νέος
images.alt_en: A young man (beside an old one).

images.alt_grc: ὁ Σωκράτης ἐν τῇ στοᾷ ἕστηκεν· ὁ Λύσις ἔξω μένει.
images.alt_en: Early morning: Socrates stands motionless in the empty stoa, lost in thought; Lysis hesitates outside.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Λύσις καὶ ὁ Σωκράτης περὶ τῶν κυλίκων καὶ τῶν νεῶν διαλέγονται.
images.alt_en: Lysis talks with Socrates, counting on his fingers; a cup and a row of ships in the thought bubble.

images.alt_grc: ἑσπέρας ὁ Λύσις τῷ πάππῳ λέγει· ἡ Ἐλπὶς γελᾷ· ὁ Λάβρος ὑπὸ τῷ δένδρῳ.
images.alt_en: Evening in the courtyard: Lysis tells Kleinias; Elpis laughs and points to Labros under the tree.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Σωκράτης
images.alt_en: Marble portrait head of Socrates, Roman copy of a Greek original of the 4th century BC (target: museum CC0 image).

images.alt_grc: ὁ ἀριθμός
images.alt_en: Numbers: pebbles on a counting board.

images.alt_grc: ἕστηκεν
images.alt_en: A man standing still.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Σωκράτης ἐν τῷ ἐργαστηρίῳ κύλικα ἔχει· ὁ Ἀρίστων πονεῖ.
images.alt_en: In the workshop Socrates turns a painted cup in his hands while Ariston works at the wheel; Mikion plays outside.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Σωκράτης τοὺς παῖδας ἐρωτᾷ περὶ τῆς ἀρετῆς.
images.alt_en: Socrates questions Lysis and Mikion; a horse and a cup drawn in the dust at their feet.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Δημόκριτος ὀργίζεται καὶ ἐξέρχεται· ὁ Σωκράτης γελᾷ.
images.alt_en: Demokritos, red-faced, storms out of the workshop door; Socrates laughs.

images.alt_grc: ἐργαστήριον κεραμέως
images.alt_en: Attic vase painting of a potter's or metalworker's workshop, with customers watching (target: museum CC0 image, e.g. the Foundry Cup's workshop scene).

images.alt_grc: ἡ ψυχή
images.alt_en: A tiny winged soul (eidolon) as painted on Athenian white-ground lekythoi.

images.alt_grc: ὁ κόσμος τῆς κύλικος
images.alt_en: The painted decoration on an Attic cup.

images.alt_grc: τοῦ θέρους καπνὸς ἐν τῇ χώρᾳ· ἐν τῇ πόλει πολλοὶ νοσοῦσιν.
images.alt_en: Summer 430: smoke from the ravaged countryside beyond the walls; inside, crowded huts and people sick in the shade.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Κλεινίας ἐν τῇ κλίνῃ· ἡ οἰκία περὶ αὐτόν· ἡ Ἐλπὶς τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἔχει.
images.alt_en: Night, lamplight: Kleinias in bed, the family round him; Elpis holds his hand.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Κλέοβις καὶ ὁ Βίτων τὴν ἅμαξαν ἕλκουσιν.
images.alt_en: Kleobis and Biton pulling their mother's cart to Hera's sanctuary, drawn as a memory in the lamp's glow.

images.alt_grc: λήκυθος λευκή
images.alt_en: White-ground funerary lekythos with Hermes or Charon and small winged souls, Athens, later 5th century BC (target: museum CC0 image).

images.alt_grc: ὁ πρέσβυς
images.alt_en: An old man with a stick.

images.alt_grc: τὸ τέκνον
images.alt_en: A mother with her child.

images.alt_grc: ὁ λοιμός
images.alt_en: Plague: sick people lying in a crowded shelter.
